Actual VIP-18 design pressure, MAWP, pipe spec/wall/grade and trapped length between XV-101 and XV-102: Scales liquid-full time and time to design; if real MAWP >230 psig design times shift but conclusion unchanged unless MAWP >> 1000 psig

Actual trapped inventory: liquid level/fill at isolation and pressure PT-101/PT-102 at XV-102 closure: Determines 0.70 vs 0.95 case — even low fill fails in 66h at 30 W/m, so fill reduction alone not a safeguard

Actual heat leak / vacuum state: annulus vacuum pressure and TI-101 to TI-104 skin temps: If vacuum proven <3 W/m, 10-day exposure would stay <design (261h to design); if degraded/lost vacuum, fails in 26-78h — determines if maintenance window can be extended

PSV-101 set point, certified capacity, and HV-101 position indication: Simulator holds pressure at set point but does not check capacity — if undersized, pressure will exceed design despite valve lifting; if HV-101 closed, protection is defeated
Relief header / flare backpressure and routing from PSV-101: High backpressure raises effective set — must verify capacity at worst header pressure
